contracts.name: Qard / Qard Hassan
contracts.how: Interest-free demand deposit or benevolent loan where borrower/bank guarantees 100% principal repayment without promising any financial return.
contracts.risk: Principal guaranteed; zero return promised (nominal administrative/Takaful recovery allowed where approved by ACE).
contracts.uses: Current accounts, salary accounts, AltBank Qard Hassan Salary Advance.

contracts.name: Mudarabah
contracts.how: Partnership between Rab-ul-Mal (investor/depositor providing capital) and Mudarib (bank/fund manager providing expertise).
contracts.risk: Profits shared via pre-agreed ratio (e.g., 70:30); financial losses borne solely by investor unless caused by manager negligence.
contracts.uses: Savings accounts, Term Deposits (JAPSA, Summit MTD), Mutual Funds, AT1 Sukuk.

contracts.name: Musharakah / Diminishing Musharakah
contracts.how: All partners contribute capital and share equity. In Diminishing Musharakah, client gradually buys out the bank's equity units.
contracts.risk: Profits shared by agreement; losses strictly proportional to capital contribution. Client pays rent on bank's unpurchased share.
contracts.uses: Home mortgages (Jaiz Home Finance, LOTUS Homes), SME equity partnerships.

contracts.name: Murabaha
contracts.how: Institution purchases a tangible asset/commodity at client's request and resells it to client at cost + disclosed fixed profit margin.
contracts.risk: Institution bears asset ownership risk prior to resale; once sold, price is fixed and cannot increase even on late payment.
contracts.uses: Auto finance, appliances, solar systems, trader inventory (MFT), LPO & trade finance.

contracts.name: Ijarah / Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek
contracts.how: Institution buys an asset and leases its usufruct (right of use) to client for agreed rentals, with separate gift/sale transfer at lease end.
contracts.risk: Lessor retains ownership and major structural maintenance risk during lease; lessee pays periodic rentals.
contracts.uses: Equipment leasing, device upgrades, FMBN Non-Interest Mortgage, Sovereign FGN Sukuk.

contracts.name: Istisna'a
contracts.how: Contract to manufacture, build, or construct a specified asset with staged delivery and flexible milestone payments.
contracts.risk: Contractor/bank bears construction completion risk; price and delivery specs fixed upfront.
contracts.uses: Factory construction (BOI NIB), real estate development, infrastructure projects.

contracts.name: Salam
contracts.how: Full payment made upfront at contract signing for future delivery of standardized commodities/crops at a specified future date.
contracts.risk: Buyer provides working capital upfront; seller delivers specified quantity/quality of goods at harvest/maturity.
contracts.uses: Agricultural crop/input financing (Jaiz Bank, Tijarah MFB, Marble Commodities Fund).

contracts.name: Wakalah
contracts.how: Principal appoints an agent (Wakeel) to manage investments or administer a Takaful fund for a disclosed upfront agency fee.
contracts.risk: Principal bears investment risk and keeps returns above expected profit; agent earns fixed fee (plus optional performance incentive).
contracts.uses: TAJBank Wakalah Investment Services, Takaful operator management fee structure.

contracts.name: Sukuk
contracts.how: Certificates of equal value representing undivided ownership in tangible assets, usufruct, or projects—not debt obligations.
contracts.risk: Returns generated from underlying asset rentals or business profits rather than interest coupons.
contracts.uses: FGN Sovereign Road Sukuk, TAJBank AT1 Sukuk, Halal Fixed Income Mutual Funds.

contracts.name: Tabarru
contracts.how: Participants contribute donations into a mutual risk pool used to indemnify members who suffer defined losses.
contracts.risk: Underwriting risk is shared mutually among participants rather than transferred to shareholders; surplus returned to participants.
contracts.uses: All 5 NAICOM-licensed Takaful operators (Noor, Jaiz, Hilal, Salam, Crown).
